request: Transform tacit expert judgments into reproducible decision patterns and quality intent derivations that humans and AI can apply to new cases
need: Scope: define a domain-general expert judgment framework that extracts tacit judgments from concrete cases, review history, and multi-expert practice, then turns them into reproducible decision patterns, quality intent derivations, and governance artifacts. Out of scope: employee surveillance, blame assignment, generic advice capture, checklist-only reduction, and treating activity counts as quality itself.
intent: Success: a non-expert human or AI agent can apply extracted decision patterns to unseen cases with acceptable agreement, explicit cues, concerns, loss boundaries, applicability limits, evidence needs, counterexamples, and governance-based revision.
